summary: Iteration 54 - Events System V2 Complete Testing. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Events page with 4 tabs (Live Events, Bibliothek, Exklusiv, Focus Sessions), premium event cards with type/tier badges, EventDetailModal with calendar integration, Focus Time Setup component.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/events returns 15 seed events
Backend: GET /api/events?tab=live returns only live/workshop events (not replays, not focus, not accelerator)
Backend: GET /api/events?tab=replay returns only replay events (4 events)
Backend: GET /api/events?tab=private returns only accelerator events (2 events)
Backend: GET /api/events?tab=focus returns only focus_session events (3 events)
Backend: Each event has google_calendar_url (valid Google Calendar URL format)
Backend: Each event has ics_content (valid ICS format with BEGIN:VCALENDAR)
Backend: Each event has outcomes array, access_level, and host fields
Backend: POST /api/events/{event_id}/register returns 200
Backend: POST /api/events/{event_id}/unregister returns 200
Backend: GET /api/focus-times returns user focus time slots
Backend: POST /api/focus-times saves focus time slots correctly
Backend: DELETE /api/focus-times/{slot_id} deletes a focus time slot
Frontend: Events page loads with data-testid='events-page'
Frontend: Tab navigation with 4 tabs (Live Events, Bibliothek, Exklusiv, Focus Sessions)
Frontend: Live Events tab shows 2 featured cards + 4 regular event cards
Frontend: Event cards have type badges (Live, Workshop, Replay, Focus, Mastermind, 1:1 Coaching)
Frontend: Event cards have tier badges (Free, Standard, Accelerator)
Frontend: Clicking event card opens EventDetailModal
Frontend: EventDetailModal has close button (data-testid='event-modal-close')
Frontend: EventDetailModal has Google Calendar button (data-testid='add-google-cal')
Frontend: EventDetailModal has Outlook/iCal button (data-testid='add-outlook-cal')
Frontend: EventDetailModal has Register button (data-testid='event-register-btn')
Frontend: Bibliothek tab shows 4 replay events
Frontend: Exklusiv tab shows 2 accelerator events with upgrade CTA
Frontend: Focus Sessions tab shows 3 focus session events
Frontend: Focus Time Setup component found (data-testid='focus-time-setup')
Frontend: Add Focus Slot button found (data-testid='add-focus-slot-btn')
critical_code_review_comments: events.py (410 lines): Well-structured with clear separation - MODELS, HELPERS, SEED DATA, ENDPOINTS sections. Calendar URL generation and ICS content generation are properly implemented.
EventsPage.js (364 lines): Clean implementation with TABS, TIER_STYLES, TYPE_STYLES constants. Uses useCallback for loadEvents. Proper separation of FeaturedEventCard and EventCard components.
EventDetailModal.js (169 lines): Handles all event types (live, replay, locked). Calendar integration with Google Calendar URL and ICS download working correctly.
FocusTimeSetup.js (227 lines): Weekly grid with DAYS and SESSION_TYPES. Add/remove slot functionality with proper form handling.
seed_data_creation: 15 events auto-seeded on first GET /api/events call: 6 live/workshop events, 4 replay events, 2 accelerator events, 3 focus session events
